title: %accumulate — running total across loop records
purpose: Add a value to a named accumulator on each loop pass, building a running total.
notes: The accumulator must be declared in {$accumulator} with _persist = true so it survives across loop records; the first argument names it.
Each loop pass adds the second argument to the current value; read the result back with @$accumulator.<name>.
The verb runs as a side effect, conventionally sunk into a throwaway field (_); its return value is the new running total.

avoid.why: an undeclared accumulator makes %accumulate return ~ on every pass, so the total reads as ~ instead of the sum
